items.title: Investor Reaction to Fed Decision Could Depend on Dissents
items.summary: Interest-rate futures show that traders see a roughly 30% chance that the Fed raises rates versus a 70% chance that it stays on hold, according to CME Group data.  Cleveland Fed President Beth Hammack and Dallas Fed President Lorie Logan are expected by many to vote in favor of raising rates.  Investors will also pay close attention to Fed Chairman Kevin Warsh’s post-meeting press conference, although the new Fed leader has been at pains to say little about the direction of rates.

items.title: Stocks Fall on Mideast Escalation Ahead of Fed Rate Decision
items.summary: U.S. stocks are skidding as the Mideast war once again raises the risk of hotter-for-longer inflation, just as Fed governors are meeting to decide on interest rates.

items.title: CME Group (CME) Stock Gets Fair Value Trim As Analysts Debate Earnings Strength
items.summary: CME Group’s fair value estimate has been trimmed from US$289.00 to about US$282.36, a reduction of roughly 2.3% that reflects updated model assumptions. This more measured price target sits alongside a split analyst narrative, with some research pointing to strong earnings and product moats, while others highlight competitive threats and softer volume assumptions. As you read on, you will see how these moving parts are shaping the evolving story around CME Group and what to watch...
